newsitem.title: THAILAND: Ekachart to split finance and securities.
newsitem.headline: Ekachart to split finance and securities.

text.p: Thailand's Ekachart Finance and Securities Plc will split its finance and securities businesses, the company said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand on Monday.
It said the firm's board had agreed at its April 25 board meeting to create a new securities company of which Ekachart Finance and Securities will hold a minimum 99 percent stake.
The liabilities and assets of Ekachart's existing securities operation will be transferred to the new firm, the company said. No timetable for the proposed split was given.
Thai brokerages which separate their finance and securities operations are eligible to apply to regulators for permission to engage in a wider range of securities and financing activities.
